## v0.3.1

- Show a persistent administrator-only history of the most recent 50 started downloads.
- Keep the active-download panel compact, match it to the requests width, and render its progress bar from the actual transferred byte percentage.
- Refresh only the active-download content while the Admin workspace is open.
- Use the configured local server timezone for Email and Slack download notifications.
- Add configurable `TZ` support and timezone data to the container image.
